required.quote: The board may require continuing education for any residential builder or remodeler licensed under this chapter; provided, however, that any residential builder or remodeler who has held a valid license under this chapter before July 1, 2015, shall be exempt from any continuing education requirements.

hours_per_period.quote: No more than two (2) hours of continuing education shall be required by the board per year.

period_years.quote: No more than two (2) hours of continuing education shall be required by the board per year.

available.quote: an occupational licensing board shall issue a license or government certification in the discipline applied for and at the same practice level to a person who establishes residence in this state if, upon application to an occupational licensing board, the applicant satisfies the following conditions

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a current and valid license in another state in an occupation with similar scope of practice for at least one year, meet minimum education/experience/examination requirements verified by the other state, have no disqualifying criminal record, not have surrendered a license for negligence or misconduct, have no pending complaints, and pay all applicable fees.
requirements.quote: The applicant holds a current and valid license in good standing in another state in an occupation with a similar scope of practice, as determined by the occupational licensing board in Mississippi, and has held this license from the occupational licensing board in the other state for at least one (1) year

definition_quote.value: "Residential builder" means any corporation, partnership or individual who constructs a building or structure for sale for use by another as a residence or who, for a fixed price, commission, fee, wage or other compensation, undertakes or offers to undertake the construction, or superintending of the construction, of any building or structure which is not more than three (3) floors in height, to be used by another as a residence, when the total cost of the undertaking exceeds Fifty Thousand Dollars ($50,000.00).
definition_quote.quote: "Residential builder" means any corporation, partnership or individual who constructs a building or structure for sale for use by another as a residence or who, for a fixed price, commission, fee, wage or other compensation, undertakes or offers to undertake the construction, or superintending of the construction, of any building or structure which is not more than three (3) floors in height, to be used by another as a residence, when the total cost of the undertaking exceeds Fifty Thousand Dollars ($50,000.00).

out_of_state_disciplinary_action_reporti.quote: Each application for a license under this chapter shall reveal any other states in which the applicant or any partner or business associate of the applicant is licensed and whether the applicant, partner or business associate has had a license revoked or suspended in any other state.

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Liability limitation clause (limiting contractor liability to cost of inspection report or contract price)
Indemnification / hold-harmless clause favoring the promisee's sole negligence
Waiver of consumer cancellation rights clause
Waiver of consumer rights (general statutory rights) clause
Blank spaces clause (material terms left blank for later completion)
Assignment of insurance proceeds clause (without owner consent / in violation of statutory requirements)
Clause authorizing unlawful entry or breach of peace for repossession
Lien disclosure notice omission (failure to include required lien disclosure)
Disclaimer or limitation of implied warranty clause
Clause entered into by unlicensed contractor (contract with unlicensed contractor)
scope__voidable_contract_clauses.quote: Any person or entity required to have a license under Section 73-59-3(1) who does not have the license provided by this chapter at the time construction, building or remodeling services are rendered may not bring any action, either at law or in equity, to enforce any contract for residential building or remodeling

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Clause requiring compliance waiver from applicable building codes or zoning regulations
Distributed energy contract clause failing to meet statutory disclosure or terms requirements
